# timeless_traces_dashboard v0.3.11 - Table of Contents

Phoenix LiveDashboard page for TimelessTraces span viewer.

## Pages

- [README](https://timeless-traces-dashboard.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://timeless-traces-dashboard.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [TimelessTracesDashboard](https://timeless-traces-dashboard.hexdocs.pm/TimelessTracesDashboard.md): Phoenix LiveDashboard page for browsing OpenTelemetry spans stored by TimelessTraces.
- [TimelessTracesDashboard.Router](https://timeless-traces-dashboard.hexdocs.pm/TimelessTracesDashboard.Router.md): Router macro for one-line LiveDashboard setup with TimelessTraces pages.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix timeless_traces_dashboard.install](https://timeless-traces-dashboard.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.TimelessTracesDashboard.Install.md): Installs TimelessTracesDashboard into your application.
